text:
```yaml
name: Fix Comment Typo in Project Update Workflow

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  fix-typo:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Dart SDK
      uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
      with:
        channel: 'stable'
        flutter-version: '3.0'

    - name: Format Dart files
      run: |
        dart format -o none lib/src/workflows/update_project_references.workflow.dart
      env:
        PATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/.pub-cache/bin:$PATH
```
